nom: COOLA Refreshing Water Plumping Gel Serum Sunscreen SPF 30

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including several who are also acne-prone, consistently report the gel feels light and does not add shine or trigger new breakouts, though one warns that very oily skin might find the hydration a bit more than it needs.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including a couple who are also mature, report the gel absorbs well and leaves skin hydrated, plump, and glowing without pilling, though one notes that very dry skin may still need a richer moisturizer layered on top.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin consistently report the gel hydrates without making their T-zone shiny, works on both drier and oilier areas of the face, and leaves a matte-to-glowy finish depending on the reviewer.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea, mostly report the gel is calming and reduces redness with no breakouts or irritation, though one reviewer with mildly sensitive skin developed an itchy red rash within hours of applying it.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin report the gel hydrates, plumps, and layers well without pilling, though the one reviewer who tracked her fine lines and wrinkles over a week of use did not notice a visible reduction in either.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report the plumping formula visibly softens the look of fine lines, dehydration lines, and under-eye hollows; however, the one reviewer who specifically tracked her fine lines and wrinkles over a week of daily use reports no significant visible reduction.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the gel as strongly hydrating and plumping, thanks to hyaluronic acid, aloe, and coconut water; a couple say the hydration doesn't last the full day or isn't quite enough for very dry skin without an extra moisturizer layered on top.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including ones with rosacea, report the formula calms redness and causes no irritation; however, a cluster of other reviewers describe serious adverse reactions, including facial swelling, itching, and in two cases a rash or photocontact dermatitis with red or pus-filled bumps that took days to resolve.
concerns.barrier: The one reviewer who raises her skin barrier directly, living in a polluted and humid area, reports the serum left her barrier feeling stronger and her previously congested, dull skin looking healthier.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who describe themselves as acne-prone or oily, including several who say sunscreen usually breaks them out, report this one causes no new breakouts and doesn't clog pores; one reviewer's severe adverse reaction included red bumps that developed into white, pus-filled, acne-like bumps.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers with oily skin report the gel does not add shine or grease and even helps keep T-zone oil in check through the day; one reviewer reports the opposite, that her face got very oily and sweaty, though this happened when she layered it with other skincare products.

extraits.texte: I got this product thinking it was a great idea to add to my routine. Within 1 hour of applying in the morning before my normal make up routine my face was tingling. I didn't think to much into it and the tingle got stronger. So I washed my face with a gentle cleanser and my mouth area along with my eye lids were beat red, swollen and itching. Will not ever use a coola product.

I have spent hundreds of dollars on sunscreens trying to find one that works for my face that isn't immediately discontinued after finding (looking at you, Hang Ten+COOLA Classic Face). With that in mind, I tried this serum, and ended up getting photocontact dermatitis after being outside on a hot, sunny day. Resulting in a very hot, flush face, red bumps, which developed into white pus-filled acne-like bumps, and took a week for my face to go back to normal. This isn't the only COOLA sunscreen product that caused this issue on my face, and only my face. Other than the Avobenzone which is linked to this issue, I haven't been able to identify the reason why some sunscreens with it cause this issue and some do not. So, because this product has caused me pain, both physically and mentally, heck I'll throw emotionally in there too as my feelings were hurt, I cannot recommend it to others like myself. It is now thrown into the basket full of sunscreens condemned for body use only.

Tried a tester at a local spa. Went on smooth and fragrance was not overpowering, but I developed an itchy red rash within a couple hours on my face and neck in the areas I applied this product. I have fair skin that is mildly sensitive to products.

I am a fifty-two years young beauty enthusiast with mature combination menopausal acne prone skin with fine lines, wrinkles, and enlarged pores. I was very excited to receive this cruelty free product because it features BlueScreen Digital De-Stress Technology. My job involves me spending most of my day in front of a computer screen. I have developed a deep wrinkle between my eyebrows. I love that this sunscreen is a gel serum. I have been applying two pumps to my cleansed face for seven days before applying my makeup. My skin feels hydrated without feeling oily. Unfortunately, as with most skincare products, I have not noticed any significant reduction in the appearance of my fine lines and wrinkles. Thank you, Coola, for being cruelty free and not testing your products on animals. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I received the product complementary to sample by my opinions are my own. I love the Refreshing Water Plumping Gel Serum. I have been using this product and I felt in love with it. I have sensitive skin and I suffer from rosacea. This product has been one of the softest products I have ever used. My skin feels fresh and the redness in my face has gone down a lot. This product is very gentle with my skin.

As a mature, dry skinned woman, this sunscreen checks all the boxes. It blends seamlessly into my skin, without any white cast. I've tried it at the end of my skincare routine and it works well with all my other products without pilling. Same under my makeup. That says a lot because it's hard to find a combo that works well with others. On days that I go makeup free, my skin feels and looks glowy and hydrated, which I like. It doesn't feel heavy, like you have a ton of product on with the gel like consistency. My skin feels and looks plumper. I love all the good hydrating ingredients such as Hyaluronic Acid and Coconut Water. My skin drinks it up. The Blue Screen Technology is an added benefit because we spend so much time on our phones and computers, that we don't realize the damaging effects on our skin. As someone with very oily, acne-prone skin, finding a sunscreen that feels weightless all day is both difficult and expensive. Many SPF products feel greasy, heavy, or cause breakouts, so I was skeptical about trying Coola's Refreshing Water Plumping Gel SPF30. But from the first application, I was amazed! It feels incredibly light, absorbs quickly, and leaves no sticky or oily residue. My skin stays fresh and hydrated without feeling clogged, and best of all—I haven't noticed any new breakouts since using it, which is a huge relief. It layers well under makeup and doesn't pill, making it perfect for daily wear. I've been searching for a sunscreen that truly works for my skin, and this one checks all the boxes. I can't wait to see the long-term benefits and will absolutely repurchase. Highly recommend for anyone struggling to find a lightweight, non-greasy SPF!
